title: Growth config: CORPORATE_POLICY
description: Corporate programme rules (GRW-P4-C): which eligibility checks are on, the funding mode, the code format and the aggregate floor of employer reports. No price, discount value or ceiling lives here: those are per-account terms set by ops after the contract (NEEDS_HUMAN). Money relevant: two-person rule. Added in the unreleased 1.14.0 set. PROPOSED_DEFAULT until ratified. Unknown keys rejected; the aggregate floor can be raised, never below 10.

enabled.description: Master switch of the rule set (the launch-locked flag growth.corporate still decides whether anything runs).

openCode.description: A code usable by anyone who holds it (up to its redemption cap).

domainEmail.description: Eligibility by the domain of a verified Passport e-mail claim. Never an unverified address.

hrList.description: Eligibility by a two-person-approved HR list (keyed hashes only, deleted after the matching window).

fundingMode.description: SPONSOR_CREDIT: the corporate funds a ceiling in its own separate benefit ledger. PLATFORM_PROMO: Kiorex funds it as a marketing expense (counsel and CFO decide).

minAggregateK.description: Smallest group an employer or ops report may show. The floor 10 is a safety control, not a preference.

length.description: Characters of the Crockford base32 code (no I, L, O, U). PROPOSED_DEFAULT 10.

groupSize.description: Display grouping with a hyphen; 0 = none. Hyphens and spaces are ignored on input.

matchWindowDays.description: Days an approved list can be matched; after that its hashed rows are deleted. PROPOSED_DEFAULT 30 (privacy, counsel to confirm).

maxRows.description: Largest list one upload may carry.
